leads.name: Monte Sano champion basswood (Cold Spring Loop)
leads.reason: no photo or exact pin in reach: only a forester's blog (Steve Jones, 26 Oct 2022) places a state champion basswood trailside on the Cold Spring Loop, 113 ft tall, 63 ft spread, 41 in DBH at July 2016 measure with heart rot at the base; no distance, no GPS, and the post does not say state park or Land Trust preserve. Trailhead 150 Fearn St SE. Need the Alabama Forestry Commission list location.

leads.name: Maple Hill Cemetery trees
leads.reason: no size or age per tree: the city tree trail layer (maps.huntsvilleal.gov Cemetery/CityCemeteries MapServer layer 8, needs Referer https://maps.huntsvilleal.gov/maplehilltreetrail/ and --http1.1) holds species and coordinates for every tagged tree but no girth or age; NRHP nomination mentions 'numerous historic plantings, especially oak, dogwood and maple'. Needs a person on site or a girth source to pick a trunk. Query saved at out/tmp/hsv_trees.json.
